text: I can explain what AWS CloudFormation is and why it is used over manual console deployments
I understand the difference between a CloudFormation template and a CloudFormation stack
I can identify the only mandatory section in a CloudFormation template (Resources)
I understand the concept of layered architecture and why infrastructure is deployed in separate stacks
I can explain how cross-stack references work using Outputs, Export, and Fn::ImportValue
I successfully deployed the networking layer (lab-network stack) using CloudFormation
I successfully deployed the application layer (lab-application stack) that references the network stack
I understand how to update a running stack using a new template and can interpret a Change Set preview
I understand the difference between Replacement=False and Replacement=True in a change set
I can explain the three DeletionPolicy values: Delete, Retain, and Snapshot
I successfully deleted the lab-application stack and verified an EBS snapshot was created
I understand what Infrastructure Composer (CloudFormation Designer) is and how to use it
I can explain the intrinsic functions: !Ref, !Sub, !GetAtt, and Fn::ImportValue
I understand why the lab uses Amazon Linux 2 and what the recommended upgrade path is (AL2023)
I understand the security implications of allowing SSH from 0.0.0.0/0 and the best practices to avoid it
